reviews.title: It was great….
reviews.text: I really loved this app, so much so that I actually purchased it years ago. I recently upgraded my phone, and after downloading it again. It would not restore my purchase. I then went to the frequently asked questions, which told me to download another version of the alarm app, I did and still could not restore or find my purchase. It’s unfortunate because I really did love this app (so much so, I recommended it to others). I also emailed them, but I have got no response after two weeks  I will never buy anything from this company ever if I’m gonna have to buy their app more than once.

reviews.title: Ads block it from working
reviews.text: I don’t mind watching a couple ads, but the ads get stuck on permanently. It says add one of two in the first ad plays, and it never goes to the second ad and you can’t click any anything except for the buttons that take you to that website and then still, the alarm won’t work. I pay for an alarm that you can’t get to work in the first place.

reviews.title: Ads that won’t close or be close
reviews.text:
Not sure what is going on with the free version, but there is now and has been individual ads that do not time out and close and have a timed X or Close. This bug does not and will not allow use of any app function/edits.

I have always dealt with the ads because having to watch an ad is the price I pay for a free version. But this is now for me looking for a different free version.

I’ve had it on my phone for several years but lately I am trapped in the opening ad and it seems to take forever to get to the clock. It is an endless loop.  I only use this app when I travel as I like to have a bedside clock. Twice this week I gave up just trying to get to the clock because I could not stop the ad at the beginning. I found another app and I’m deleting this now!

reviews.title: Alarm Quit Working
reviews.text: I have had this app and the Alarm Clock HD app for several years because they were the best free apps that allowed me to play music from my iPhone as a wake up alarm. Over the past year both of them have stopped doing this and now this app alarm will not even go off. I have tried to turn my phone off and back on as well as remove and reinstall the app and neither works. Also there is no way to contact customer support if you go to their website. It is a shame that apps that were so good can’t be maintained.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text: I had this app for a few years and it worked well. Then, over the past few months, the alarm stopped going off consistently without warning. I noticed if I woke up and looked at another app, not closing this alarm clock app, and going back to sleep set this app back to focus (showing the clock on my phone) sometimes it won't sound. Other times it wouldn't sound at the designated time, but would hours after the designated time. I need consistency. I uninstalled the app.

reviews.title: Sad demise to a once great app

Ads are OK as long as they do not interfere with the integrity of the product. Do not expect potential clients to pay for an ad free version when the basic product does not function correctly.

reviews.title: Used to love this but can’t count on it anymore
reviews.text:
I have to take medication at very specific times during the day. I used to be able to count on this alarm to alert me to the time and even to wake me up for my pill times. Lately though the alarm shuts off quickly or doesn’t sound at all. I end up sleeping through pill times which really causes me pain when it is time for my morphine dose. 
I love the graphics but they are useless if the alarms don’t sound.
